source_title: 대륙 반대편에서 오는 새끼 기다리는 것도 파티 매너임?
subtitle: 새벽 인던 파티에 반대편 대륙에서 배 타고 오는 딜러

cuts.speaker: 언데드 성기사
cuts.dialogue:
새벽에 한 판 돌고 자려는데
도적 왜 반대편 대륙이냐?
cuts.visual_prompt: Low-angle dungeon entrance shot in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal stone floor touch and zero text or speech bubbles. On the left, sleepy Undead Paladin protection tank (1H mace and sturdy gold shield resting beside her on the stone, tired heavy-lidded golden eyes) unrolls a parchment two-continent fantasy world map pointing grimly at a tiny glowing dot far across the painted ocean. On the right, gentle Tauren Druid healer (single leafy wooden staff stowed on back) leans over peeking at the map with wide blinking eyes and twitching cow-hood ears.

cuts.speaker: 노움 도적
cuts.dialogue:
던전 앞에서 신청해야 돼?
몰랐네~ 이제 배 타러 가!
cuts.visual_prompt: Side-profile breezy ocean travel shot in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal blue splash wave touch and zero text or speech bubbles. On the right, carefree Gnome Rogue (bare unadorned blonde twin pigtails with pink/blue tips, zero hairpins, green forehead goggles, twin green daggers sheathed at waist) perches happily on the wooden rail of a tiny cute 2.5-head chibi SD fantasy sailboat waving casually while sipping from an uncorked glass flask with the wooden cork visibly held in her other hand as a tiny cute 2.5-head chibi SD seagull glides past.

cuts.speaker: 노움 도적
cuts.dialogue:
다들 딴 거 하다 합류하던데?
그리핀 타고 금방 갈게~
cuts.visual_prompt: High-angle comedic split-distance confrontation shot in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal stone floor touch and zero text or speech bubbles. On the left, shameless Gnome Rogue (bare unadorned blonde twin pigtails with pink/blue tips, zero hairpins, green forehead goggles, twin green daggers sheathed at waist) flashes a breezy thumbs-up grinning happily while casually hopping onto a cute 2.5-head chibi SD feathery gryphon mount. On the right, exhausted Undead Paladin protection tank (1H mace and sturdy gold shield resting beside her) holds a glowing blue party-whisper rune crystal staring in utter disbelief with a twitching eyebrow.

Centered Dutch-tilt extreme big bust-up close-up filling 82 percent of frame height in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with heavy sleep-deprived gloom lines and zero text or speech bubbles. Utterly drained Undead Paladin protection tank (round white skull cap, silver bob, 1H mace and sturdy gold shield resting just behind her shoulder) stares hollowly straight ahead with dark tired shadows under her wide blank golden eyes, slack jaw, and a tiny floating translucent ghost-soul drifting out of her mouth.

cuts.speaker: 타우렌 드루이드
cuts.dialogue:
그래도 어렵게 구한 딜러인데
좀만 이해하고 기다려주자~
cuts.visual_prompt: Over-the-shoulder shot from behind frozen Undead Paladin protection tank (round white skull cap and sturdy gold shield strap in lower-left foreground) looking at Tauren Druid healer on the right, in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background (zero text or speech bubbles). On the right, overly kind Tauren Druid healer (single leafy wooden staff stowed on back) presses both empty hands together with an apologetic soft smile and pleading shiny brown eyes asking for patience.

cuts.speaker: 언데드 성기사
cuts.dialogue:
남의 시간은 시간 아니냐?!
같은 대륙서 신청해! 파탈!
cuts.visual_prompt: Back-view wide slapstick comic finale in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal stone floor touch and zero text or speech bubbles. On the left, fed-up Undead Paladin protection tank (1H mace and sturdy gold shield strapped neatly on back) marches briskly away holding up a glowing cyan-swirl oval hearthstone in a crisp swirling teleport sparkle leaving the party immediately. On the right, flustered Tauren Druid healer (single leafy wooden staff stowed on back) reaches out desperately with empty trembling hands crying big cartoon tears as the party falls apart.
